caption:
AdAI has been live for 3 days and still has zero public pricing page. I'm writing about it anyway.

It launched September 11, 2026 out of Revolution Venture Studios, a New York startup studio — not a solo founder side project. And it's doing something different than the usual "type a prompt, get an ad" tools flooding the market: it uses AI agents that pull from your actual brand assets — logos, product shots, past creative — plus your brand guidelines, and output finished image AND video ads from the same workflow. Not fifty random drafts to sort through. Finished files.

Here's the part I'm not going to gloss over: there's no confirmed pricing, no independent hands-on reviews, and no track record yet on whether the output needs heavy editing before it's actually postable. That's usually where early ad-AI tools quietly fall apart — the week-one demo looks great, the month-one reality is messier.

If you manage paid social or brand creative and you're sick of prompt-engineering your way to something on-brand, this is worth bookmarking and checking back on in a few weeks once real users have run actual campaigns through it.

This post contains affiliate links. Full breakdown — link in bio.
